messages:
nina: Opening a docs PR for IPSec/strongSwan guidance targeted at Private deployments to reach on-prem KMS/HSM. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/ZZZZ. Need quick review on cert vs PSK examples and air-gapped packaging.

tom: Nice. Please include an IKEv2 cert-based example (enterprise prefers certs) plus a PSK fallback. Show where to place p12 in an offline bundle.

liu: Add a short MTU/fragments section. Recommend starting MTU=1396 for ether 1500 when using ESP. Show how to test: `ping -s 1400 -M do` and `iperf3 -M 1400`.

erin: Include minimal nftables + iptables snippets and a systemd unit for strongswan. Also document `modprobe af_key esp4` for older kernels in offline bundles.

tom: Add test/debug commands: `swanctl --list-sas`, `ip xfrm state`, `sudo journalctl -u strongswan -f`. For connectivity check: `curl --interface <tunnel-ip> https://kms.example.com:7443/healthz`.

nina: Draft snippets I'll land: simplified /etc/ipsec.conf with cert example, /etc/ipsec.secrets p12 line, manifest for offline bundle (`/opt/offline/redwood/kms-ipsec/`) and postinstall script that imports p12 and sets perms.

liu: Vendor caveat: some HSMs require management-plane source IP allowlists; recommend staging tunnel in parallel and testing HSM admin port before cutover. Call out scheduling a maintenance window for final switch.

erin: Troubleshooting table please: symptom/likely cause/quick check (ex: "IKE SA not established" -> missing cert trust -> `swanctl --list-certs`).

ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/ZZZZ (files: docs/private/ipsec-strongswan-kms.md, examples/ipsec-manifest.md)

nina: Thanks all 1 will incorporate these edits and mark "needs eng-sre validation" in PR checklist for a quick smoke on a VM.
